title: Preserve pan automation independently from static balance
scope: Add a general authored pan/balance event representation and retain supported GPIF/legacy values through GP8.
acceptance: Retain two pan changes on one track without changing its initial balance.
Document exact public units and conversion from GPIF channel-strip and legacy mix-table values.
Validate endpoints, ordering and track ownership; independently assert exported events.
exclusions: Other legacy mix-table controllers remain in mix-table.
